newsitem.title: USA: Government Tech Services wins contracts.
newsitem.headline: Government Tech Services wins contracts.

text.p: Government Technology Services Inc said the Naval Information Systems Management Center awarded it two contracts and signed two agreements with the company.

Government Tech did not say how much the contracts were worth. Under them, the company will provide the center with computer hardware, software and peripherials from Hewlett-Packard, Apple and other companies.
Under the two agreements, the company will supply personal computers and Panasonic notebook computers. It said the agreement on Panasonic computers was worth $10 million.
